ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Service Binary Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a service binary running in a suspicious directory

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.bin.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\All\\ Users\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Default\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Contacts\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Searches\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\config\\\\systemprofile\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Fonts\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\IME\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\addins\\\\.*")) AND (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$")))
